title: 病毒涌现 · 10张低饱和度宣传图
constraints: 低饱和度；微观细胞、病毒、免疫与机制卡牌；无小鼠、无器官；宣传演绎图，不标注为实机截图。

new_image_prompts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing, compositing actual project sprites. Generate ONE finished horizontal 16:9 promotional image for Chinese indie game 《病毒涌现》. Reference image1 is the USER-APPROVED LOW-SATURATION campaign image: match its restrained chroma, dark navy/charcoal-violet organic fiber background, muted brick red tissue cells, subdued amber viruses, soft grey-cyan immune colors, ivory/antique champagne gold typography and fine old gold ornament. Maintain this same saturation or slightly LOWER: absolutely no neon, bright yellow, oversaturated reds, blazing orange, intense bloom or laser beams. Keep readable tonal separation and crisp pixel-art sprite identity. Other references are actual project sprite/card art; preserve recognizable silhouettes and internal pixel details but grade their colors down to match image1. Microorganisms/cells/virus only. NO mouse, NO rats, NO animal bodies, NO animal observation UI, NO lungs/organs, no humans. Promotional illustrated game scene inspired by implemented gameplay, no claim of actual screenshot. No fake numeric HUD, QR, download button, awards, other brands or extra English. Use clean precise readable Chinese. Keep short text, ample breathing room and strong art direction. Do not copy the scene or wording of reference1; create the new requested scene and exact text below.

Theme: leave a small squad to continue infecting while the main swarm moves on. Top-down scene across center and right: one large muted red cell at lower middle with exactly three tiny amber viruses attached along its membrane; the main swarm of many small orange-ochre viruses moves away along a curved tissue corridor toward another distant red cell. A modest dashed arc separates the squad and the departing main swarm. Do not depict cell-to-cell teleporting. Image2 card illustration supplies the attachment visual; images3 and4 supply cell designs, infected cell ochre-gold graded muted. Upper left clean negative space for text. Small name '病毒涌现'; headline two lines '留下感染小队' / '让传播继续'; subtitle '主群向前，接力不断'; bottom understated feature text '感染接力 · 分群经营'. Full atmospheric game scene, no giant card overlay.

Theme: many swarms, multiple decisions. Beautiful wide top-down tissue map with winding narrow navy-purple fiber corridors, six DISTINCT small amber virus clusters in separate places, distributed around red host cells, with restrained amber dotted branching routes linking zones. Virus groups must be tiny relative to cells, preserve actual orange spiky silhouette. Some groups waiting at membrane, others travelling, clear sense of distributed control. Strategic wide overview, not enormous close-up cell. Main title centered across upper quarter with fine old gold line: small '病毒涌现'; headline '一群分为多群，策略遍布全局'; subtitle '分裂扩容，协同建立感染网络'; bottom small '分裂 · 切群 · 集合 · 留守'. Reference2 informs multigroup expansion only; do not render a big card. No fabricated interface.

Theme: strategic hiding. A quietly tense close-up of one subdued ochre infected cell at left-center, a small amber virus cluster partially sheltered just within its translucent outer membrane; preserve actual infected cell form and kidney-shaped nucleus from image3. Image2 is visual reference for sheltered virus pockets, not literal magical portals. Pale grey-blue macrophage passes in background slightly out of focus, not attacking. Plenty dark tissue shadow and low-key light, quieter mood than other campaign graphics. Right 40% typography: small '病毒涌现'; large two-line headline '暂隐于细胞' / '等待下一次扩散'; subtitle '寄居藏身，进退由你'; bottom fine feature text '寻找掩护 · 保留生机'. No invulnerability bubble or guarantee of escape. Theme: decoy and emergency dash. Diagonal top-down tissue scene from upper left to lower right. A small handful of released amber virus particles remain along a side route while a larger cohesive main virus cluster dashes around the curved edge of a muted brick-red tissue cell toward safety. One large pale blue-grey macrophage is investigating the side-route particles. Use restrained amber dotted motion traces, no electric beams, no rocket fire, no explosion. Keep dashing cluster crisp, use subtle short motion echoes. Reference2 decoy placement and reference3 motion only; no large cards. Typography upper right open space: small '病毒涌现'; headline two lines '以诱饵争取时间' / '用冲刺抓住生机'; subtitle '脱落诱饵 × 紧急冲刺'; lower small '判断时机，转移追逐'. Avoid claiming decoys always work.

Theme: viral release from infected host cell, NOT virus self-division. Macro pixel-art detail across right 65% of a muted ochre-red infected cell edge: several tiny spherical orange spiky viruses at DIFFERENT budding states along the membrane, shallow protrusion, pinched neck, released complete particles. Image2 supplies the actual spiky virus design; image3 provides infected-cell release motif (do not depict rupture, this image is about budding); generate the small budding neck at the membrane as described. Underlying large cell faint kidney-shaped nucleus echoes image4. Released particles drift gently toward small distant red cells, giving cause and effect. Tiny viruses, large host membrane, restrained amber light without neon or exaggerated explosions. Left text field: small '病毒涌现'; huge headline two lines '从细胞出芽' / '向更远处扩散'; subtitle '观察感染、释放与传播的连锁反应'; lower small '微观过程 · 动态模拟'. Theme: local flow redirection and path choice. Top-down curved organic tissue channels with red host cells acting as obstacles. Thin soft grey-blue stream ribbons curve naturally through dark tissue lanes. A local bend of the current guides several tiny amber virus clusters around one cell and onward through an open passage. One simple understated directional sweep near the bend suggests player-directed LOCAL flow, not a force field. Reference2 provides stream direction motif, keep muted and non-glowing. Distinct composition with a sweeping S-shaped path through entire canvas; text rests in upper-left dark cavity. Small game name '病毒涌现'; headline two lines '改变局部流向' / '开辟传播路线'; subtitle '顺势而行，也能主动转流'; bottom small '组织流动 · 绕障探索 · 局部转流'. No huge cards or invented terrain types.

Theme: protect an infected node as immune pressure rises. A medium-large subdued ochre infected cell lower right based on image3 with a THIN localized amber membrane sheath, inspired by actual node-cover card image2; depict a gentle biological coating, not a magical sci-fi shield. One small cyan-grey T cell from image4 touches its boundary, while pale blue-grey macrophage from image5 investigates free virus particles farther away. Several tiny ochre virus clusters occupy the surrounding tissue lanes, restrained tension. T cell attacks infected cell by contact, macrophage pursues free virus, no T-cell laser guns. The single coating is temporary protection, no invincibility portrayal. Upper left title space: small '病毒涌现'; large headline two lines '守住感染节点' / '应对免疫升级'; subtitle '节点包覆，为群体争取一次机会'; bottom fine '节点经营 · 免疫博弈'. Lower image1's red and orange saturation by approximately 35 percent; turn bright red into dusty burgundy/terracotta and bright orange into muted amber-ochre. Reduce purple/cyan chroma slightly and soften orange glow. Keep text warm ivory and champagne gold, readable; do not darken overall exposure.
